aggregators._comment: TIER 0 — try these BEFORE writing any custom venue adapter. All probed live 2026-08-01: each returned a clean auth error, meaning the endpoint is real and only needs a key.

predicthq.note: The one real tier-1/2 aggregator. Hundreds of sources, ~20M events; explicitly covers conferences, performing arts, expos, community. Measure NYC coverage FIRST.

seatgeek.note: Open + documented, free client_id. Broader long tail than Ticketmaster.

eventbrite_organizers.note: Public SEARCH is dead (Feb 2020). But organizer/event pages are public with JSON-LD, and eventbrite.com is the #1 linked host in NYC curation. Harvest organizer IDs from curation and follow those specific organizers. Never a sweep. Re-read terms first.

songkick.note: Music long tail, key by request.

curation_feeds._comment: Roster DISCOVERY only. Count outbound link hosts to rank which venues to approach directly. NEVER parse the prose into events -- that is extracting editorial labour and would need an LLM, which the pipeline bans.

curation_ranked._comment: First run of the link-host frequency count across coolstuffnyc + theskint, 2026-08-01. Evidence-ranked and reproducible -- better input than any single recommendation. Excludes self/social/CDN hosts. Rebuild weekly; it updates itself for free.

hosts.note: Not a venue -- the #1 destination. See aggregators.eventbrite_organizers.
